name: migration-ready-schema
description: Data-model rules that make a schema importable from day one, so the migration-import-engineer is never blocked on missing columns. Every SMB Product-Builder product must let a customer bring their data from an incumbent (ServiceTitan/Toast/Mindbody/Shopify) — that requires provenance (source_ref) and rollback (import_batch_id) on importable entities, and modelling real-world actors as entities rather than inline fields.
